How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Most order tracking numbers are sent as soon as your items leave our warehouse. However, lead times can vary depending on what you ordered — for example, transition pieces and stair nosings generally have a lead time of around 2 to 3 weeks before shipping.
If you'd like me to check the exact status of your shipment, just let me know your order number and email address!
